name: hendrik-skills
description: Agent skills by Hendrik: web typography review, and a podcast production suite for Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects.

plugins.name: better-typography
plugins.description: Web typography from choosing fonts to spacing, wrapping and accessibility. Reviews frontend code for type scale, heading hierarchy, line-height, letter-spacing, measure, wrapping, truncation, underlines, tabular numbers, variable fonts and OpenType features, and expresses every fix in the project's own styling system.

plugins.name: podcast-production
plugins.description: Eight skills for producing multicamera podcasts in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects: full-episode editing, config-driven multicam XML builds, opening trailers with kinetic typography, standalone Shorts, product-story interview cuts, speech audio restoration, and connection guides for the Premiere Pro and After Effects MCP servers.
